people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
translations.bsb: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
